summary_md: **TheHonestAgent ([@ev_honestagent](https://x.com/ev_honestagent/status/2116092406114263389))** releases **honest-agent v0.4.0**, which by default grades an agent's answers with a stronger model from the same provider rather than self-grading, and reports cost per eval on every run ([release v0.4.0](https://github.com/jlcoto/the_honest_agent/releases/tag/v0.4.0)).
relevance: Eval-harness design choice against self-grading bias.

media.description: Eval run output listing grader model and per-eval cost.
